summary: Birks Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K on August 6, 2026, attaching a press release dated August 5, 2026, announcing the resignation of Director Emilio B. Imbriglio for personal reasons, effective immediately. Imbriglio had served since 2022 and was not standing for re-election at the September 2026 annual meeting. The board thanked him, and Executive Chairman Niccolò Rossi di Montelera acknowledged his contributions. This is a voluntary director departure, not a routine meeting notice. No deal terms are involved; watch for potential board composition changes or succession plans.
